item.text: The campaign is live with both approved posts accepted, a $200 daily limit, and a $1,000 line-item lifetime cap ending at midnight Pacific after July 20. I’m scheduling a daily check during the flight and will pause the line item at the end before reporting totals.

After the first day, spend is $197.08 against the $200 daily limit, with 139,495 impressions and 52 link clicks. Delivery is on pace and remains below the total cap, so I’m keeping the setup as is and checking again tomorrow.

At the July 20 check, the fourth day added $195.49 in spend, 101,453 impressions, and 48 link clicks. Daily delivery has stayed around $195–$199, under the daily cap. I’ll collect the final day’s totals after the scheduled end, then confirm the ad group is no longer active.

The Summer Relief Petition campaign ran from July 16 through July 20, 2027, targeting US residents aged 18+ and promoting both approved posts.

- **Spend:** $988.34 of the $1,000 cap
- **Impressions:** 651,516
- **Link clicks:** 237

The line item is now paused. X could not report completed signatures because the site has no X pixel.
